item.title: Group Workshops
item.description: Hands-on group workshops for community spaces, cultural events, and creative gatherings. Good for Beginner-friendly introductions Short sessions (1–3 hours) or multi-week series Team-building and cultural programming

item.title: Institutional Workshops
item.description: Workshops designed for museums, festivals, galleries, and organizations — combining demonstration, storytelling, and guided making.

item.title: Private Classes
item.description: Private one-on-one (or small group) classes tailored to your level — from beginner foundations to advanced patterns and finishing. Typical topics Loom setup & warping Basic knots & weaving techniques Pattern reading & color planning Finishing and care
